cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Closer on My Terms
cards.instruction: Agree to repair the relationship while redefining closeness around the boundaries that benefit you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like a weekend to patch things up. I'll book separate rooms, and we'll keep the old arguments out of dinner.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The old arguments are why we need the weekend.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then tell me the worst of it over coffee. I'll leave the afternoon free for a walk together.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can't get through everything over coffee.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Send the rest by email. I can take it a bit at a time, and we can still have our walk.

heightening.evidence: A5 agrees to receive more while controlling when and how it reaches A.

specificity.evidence: Rooms, dinner, coffee, walk and email are distinct practical boundaries in A1/A3/A5.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 has one channel change and its self-serving benefit; no abstract summary of closeness.
